tidbit: Did you know… about 14,000 new articles reached our newsroom in the last 24 hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
Apple's intelligent access to Alibaba Qwen will be open for testing on November 4, according to Apple's official announcement reported by 富途牛牛.
Reported by Law360: OpenAI and Microsoft's copyright dispute has sparked a surge of legal briefs addressing the separation of artificial intelligence training and content generation.
Google, Microsoft, Anthropic and OpenAI are backing a new artificial intelligence crawling opt-out standard via robots.txt, reported by SiliconANGLE.
Reported by The Tech Buzz: Nvidia is exploring cosigning a loan for Nscale's artificial intelligence data center in West Virginia.
Anthropic has filed what could be a record-breaking initial public offering, reported by Fox Business.
Free every hour.
